name: sme-fused-transpose-1x4-tiles
hypothesis: Start from existing-sme, the strongest measured median. The panel-packing and two-step pipeline trials did not establish a gain. This candidate uses one VL-by-4VL output block across four ZA tiles and keeps transpose and multiplication in one streaming region. The hypothesis is that reusing one A vector across four adjacent B vectors reduces repeated A traffic and improves B access locality. It requires five vector loads per four outer products instead of four, so the tradeoff needs measurement. This source is untested; the supplied results do not establish the 1780 GFLOP/s target.
